limitations.note: The rewrite registers the newly computed count directly instead of sampling the pre-edge internal count, so it still exposes increments and set loads one clock earlier than expected.
The rewrite changes the asynchronous reset value of `zero` from low to high, even though the fix only needed to register `number`.
The test expects each set value on the same edge that loads it, so passing confirms the rewrite's assumption rather than checking the required one-clock output delay.
